observations.body: The saying occurs while the disciples gather in Galilee, away from the public crowds of surrounding scenes.
observations.label: Delivered, killed, and raised; the disciples grieve: textual observation

observations.body: Delivery into human hands, killing, and raising on the third day are stated without naming intermediate actors.
observations.label: Delivered, killed, and raised; the disciples grieve: action, promise, or consequence

observations.body: Matthew gives the disciples’ great sorrow rather than a question or rebuke.

payload.posture: Read Matthew 17:22–23 as its own anticipation and stated approach crucifixion setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The prediction is concise and the disciples’ emotional response is explicit, while their understanding remains unstated.
